limits: The three positive cases are private source-crop boundary calibration records; they do not assert any current public catalog binding.

For each of the two revised-boundary controls, the prior bottom band contains high-contrast (<230) ink on both sides while the revised bottom 8px bands contain no <230 pixels. Fainter components may remain; this is not a semantic or whole-context pass.

remainingLimits: Near-edge bands are candidate detectors. Blank/valid bands do not clear source readability, context, quantities, row identity, meaning, or unknown continuations.
The detector checks published PNG SHA bytes, not an exact pixel replay of each PNG from its PDF.
